title: fzf-tmux geometry arguments can execute commands
summary: Attached layout-size arguments reach Bash arithmetic without validation. Popup geometry also permits injection of tmux options that can lead to command execution.

severity.rationale: Execution requires control of command-line geometry values rather than ordinary search results. This is a conditional local tool invocation issue.

exposure: A wrapper or invocation must accept attacker-influenced geometry arguments. The arithmetic path triggers during option parsing, even outside tmux.

params.instructions: Check fzf-tmux version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade fzf and its bundled fzf-tmux script to 0.74.5 or later.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
